name: Logo Variant
author: hearth-team
description: Generate a logo concept from a description. Routes through Recraft when configured (native vector output); falls back to text-to-image providers for raster. Pass `brand` for the brand name + `concept` for what the logo should convey.

family.name: AI Image Family
family.description: Headshots, inpainting, wardrobe swap, logos, social posts. Pick a provider (OpenAI / KIE / Higgsfield / Replicate / fal / Stability / Recraft / Ideogram) and your favorite task — sub-skills route through whichever provider you've configured.

settings.label: Preferred provider
settings.help: Recraft is recommended for native vector (SVG) output.
